probe: decomposition of the study's arm-C exact defect into leak vs basis mismatch
reading: the study's exact arm-C number carries TWO defects, not one. Review C6 caught the leak (+0.082). It did NOT catch that the shape-field raw coefficients were fit in the theta=1 eigenbasis and then applied to the theta_MAP eigenbasis -- different eigenvectors, so the coefficients were transplanted between incompatible coordinate systems (-0.085). The two errors nearly cancelled, which is why 0.157 looked plausible next to the honest 0.1595.
